question: Who became only the third Indian to win a singles tennis match at Olympics in July 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sumit Nagal.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sumit Nagal became the third tennis player from India to triumph in a men's singles match during an Olympic competition.**
 
• He became **India's first winner in 25 years.** He barely defeated **Denis Istomin** in this contest.
 
• Sumit Nagal is a professional** tennis player** from India who was born on August 16, 1997. When he and his **Vietnamese partner L Hoàng Nam triumphed at the Wimbledon boys' doubles tournament in 2015**, he became the **sixth Indian player** to win a** junior Grand Slam championship.**
 
• He is now the** top-ranked singles tennis player in India,** and since 2018, he has often competed for India in the **Davis Cup.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ramkumar Ramanathan **

 
 
• Indian professional **tennis player Ramanathan Ramkumar** was born on November 8, 1994. He was ranked as high as No. 111 in singles by the **Association of Tennis Professionals (ATP)** in July 2018 and No. 58 in doubles (achieved in August 2022). He is currently India's top player. He has competed for India in **Davis Cup** matches. He was the first Indian to compete in an ATP Tour singles final since **Somdev Devvarman in 2011.**
 
 
 
• ​**Mukund Sasikumar**
 
 
• **​Indian tennis player Mukund Sasikumar** plays the game. A career-high ATP singles ranking of 229 was attained by Sasikumar on October 17, 2019. Additionally, on February 3, 2020, he achieved an** ATP doubles ranking high of 431.**
 
 
 
• **Prajnesh Gunneswaran **
 
 
• **Tennis player Prajnesh Gunneswaran **was born in India on November 12, 1989. He has won **2 ATP Challenger tournaments**, **8 ITF singles championships, and 1 ITF doubles title. **He competes for India in the Davis Cup and is now the top-ranked singles player in the country. He earned the bronze medal in the men's singles competition at the **2018 Asian Games in Jakarta.**
 
 

71
